hypothesis.claim: Removing question-text interactions permits a low-dimensional shared graph-interaction model to identify which edge credits change most across two graph contexts on other questions.
hypothesis.mechanism: The 66 pairwise graph coefficients pool evidence across training questions. Their induced conditional-credit difference supplies a label-free current-question drift ranking.
hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: The single frozen graph-only order-2 selector's top-2 mean cross-seed squared drift exceeds the uniform-top-2 expectation on the exposed 120-question development block.
not_claimed: same-question repeated-seed gain as future-question gain

data.access: Only accepted D2 arrays; no sealed or new test targets.

unique_candidate.name: D3_graph_only_order2_R3
unique_candidate.features: [1,12 edge bits,66 unordered pair products], no text/PCA features
unique_candidate.fit_target: 5-seed mean of all 24 prespecified edge-presence contrasts per training question
unique_candidate.objective: sum_i w_i(y_i-X_i beta)^2 + alpha*||beta||^2; intercept contrast column is identically zero
unique_candidate.alpha_selection: minimum tune question-mean credit MSE; within absolute 1e-12 of minimum choose largest alpha
unique_candidate.nomination: this candidate is nominated by protocol before results; only its alpha is tuned

selector.ranking: descending score; exact score ties use smaller edge index
selector.feedback_access: scores and selected indices depend only on frozen coefficients and current graph masks

controls.name: uniform_top2
controls.definition: Expected average score under uniform sampling of two distinct edges is the average over all 12 edges; compute analytically without Monte Carlo.

controls.name: B0
controls.definition: Frozen D2 train-only per-edge mean credit; graph-context drift is exactly zero. Report deterministic tied-index top-2 separately; it has no drift-ranking information.

controls.name: graph_only_order1_R3
controls.definition: 13 columns with effective 12 coefficients, same train/tune objective/grid. Drift is identically zero. Verify beta_e = Ntrain/(Ntrain+12*alpha)*B0_e. Not eligible as fallback.

controls.name: fixed_old_C2_R3
controls.definition: Use accepted D2 parameters.npz key C2_R3 (711 coefficients) with accepted phi-major feature order. No refit or new alpha selection. Same old train/tune information; descriptive comparator only.

primary_metric.squared_drift: mean_{s<t} delta_s*delta_t over all 10 distinct seed pairs; negative estimates are retained
primary_metric.selected_per_question: average squared_drift over the selector's 2 chosen edges
primary_metric.aggregate: mean over questions; two anchors are compared within each question, not treated as 240 independent samples
primary_metric.independence_assumption: Cross-seed products estimate squared conditional means only under independent seed replicates; retain audit limitations.

all_required: all provenance, algebra, candidate-freeze and integrity checks pass
spending_gate.interpretation: Exploratory resource-allocation gate on previously exposed data; not a significance/confirmation claim.
spending_gate.if_fail_or_inconclusive: STOP_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_ROUTE; preserve negative or inconclusive evidence; no substitute from controls, no change of k, score, alpha criterion, model, seed split, or metric.

conditional_independent_pilot.data_split: disjoint historical-credit calibration, new-feedback calibration, and sealed future service questions; no current service gold enters a selector/update
minimum_mechanism_controls: graph change vs matched no-change condition
targeted vs uniform-random revalidation; no-revalidation baseline
conditional_independent_pilot.costs: Record initialization, service, counterfactual revalidation, scoring, and failures; prior diagnostic does not establish matched complete cost.
conditional_independent_pilot.primary_requirement: Demonstrate effects on independent future-question decisions at matched complete budgets, not merely squared-drift enrichment.
conditional_independent_pilot.failure_boundary: No evidence of useful targeting or future service benefit at full cost => stop/narrow this candidate claim; do not infer universal impossibility of credit maintenance.

preexecution_checks: commit protocol and source hashes before using actual D3 targets
check train/tune/exposed question disjointness and exact 200/80/120 counts
check credit arrays and bit ordering match accepted D2; no extra labels
freeze chosen alpha, coefficients and selected indices before exposed-block scoring
verify order1 degeneracy and B0 zero drift
record score ties and changed-context support
recheck unchanged source/input hashes after execution

literature_boundary.scope: Graph/context-dependent attribution is existing work; eventual claim must concern selective revalidation and future service under full cost.
